messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — elevated 5xx + 429s originating from eu-west (shared-hosting cluster). Paging oncall.

maria: paging oncall for eu-west, I'm seeing a sudden 5xx spike (~18% errors) hitting hosted API routes. Affects mostly shared tenants. non-prod looks clean.

jordan: oncall here, ack. what's the observed blast radius and top signals?

maria: blast radius: shared hosting in eu-west-1 on provider-a. top errors are decode OOMs and 429s from a few heavy tenants. p95 latency up ~300ms.

avi: (joining) can we get a quick top-ten tenant list? I suspect one noisy job with long context loops.

avi: quick query results: t-3487, t-9124, t-7718 are top contributors — t-3487 is 47% of 5xx.

avi: recommendation: immediate tenant-level soft-quarantine (rate-limit) for t-3487 and reduce free-tier burst settings.

ellie: agree. Also suggest toggling some non-critical hosted features (code-completion, background-lint) to reduce memory and tracing overhead.

jordan: plan: 1) apply tenant-level rate-limit to t-3487 2) canary-reroute 10% traffic to provider-b in eu-west 3) apply free-tier throttles and brownout non-critical endpoints. @deploy-bot can you apply tenant limit?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: acknowledged. initiating tenant rate-limit update: set t-3487 -> 5rps across eu-west policy group.

ops-robot: ops-robot: applying traffic-shape: shared-hosting free-tier throttle -> 50% of baseline.

maria: executing canary reroute now: `trafficctl reroute --region eu-west --from provider-a --to provider-b --percent 10`

jordan: do it. watch p99 and 5xx.

ops-robot: trafficctl: OK — 10% traffic shifted to provider-b (eu-west). Monitoring target groups.

maria: also propose flipping `hosted.rich_embedding_cache` off for eu-west to reduce memory pressure. @ellie can you coordinate?

ellie: flipping feature flag now: `/ff toggle hosted.rich_embedding_cache off eu-west`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: feature flag toggle succeeded.

jordan: results after initial actions: 5xx dropped from 18% -> ~8% within 6m. p95 still a bit high. If stable, we should shift more traffic (up to ~40%) over next 30m.

emily-cs: alerting CS and drafting outbound to impacted customers (top 15). Short heads-up, mitigation in progress, ETA updates every 15m.

avi: ops suggestion: drain a couple of noisy GPU nodes on provider-a to force pod redistribution and free up memory, but do staged drains only. Command (example):

```
kubectl drain node/gpu-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30
```

jordan: do staged drains (1 then observe). Not full region node drains yet.

ops-robot: initiating staged drain on node/gpu-42 (provider-a). Redirecting new pods to provider-b where possible.

maria: after node drain 1 and bumping reroute to 40% total, errors reduced to ~2.3%. p95 latency coming down. Brownout: disable free-tier endpoints for code-completion + linting for 30m to reduce background load.

ellie: brownout toggles applied for free-tier endpoints in eu-west.

jordan: setting rate-limits globally for now: free-tier -> 20r/min, paid-tier -> 100r/min for shared-hosting.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rate-limit rules applied in eu-west.

maria: monitoring — errors at 2.1% and falling. Starting to stabilize but keep mitigation in place.

emily-cs: status page posted: "Degraded performance for hosted API in eu-west; mitigation underway. We'll post updates every 15 minutes."

jordan: documenting actions in incident ticket: summary, mitigation steps, commands run, metrics. tagging eng leads and product for brownout notes.

maria: oncall handoff in 30m to @oncall-2. @jordan please prepare the handoff notes and runbook.

jordan: handoff notes started in ticket. Remaining risk: provider-a may still have intermittent backend errors; plan to gradually reintroduce traffic to provider-a if stable for 1h.

oncall-2: ack — will take over monitoring at 2155004800 and continue staged rollback: 5% back to provider-a every 5m if errors <3% and p95 within SLO.

maria: agreed. If errors spike above 5% again, we escalate to broader region-failover. For now, continuing observation.

oncall-2: taking over. current metrics at takeover: errors 1.2%, p95 within SLO, traffic split provider-a:60% provider-b:40%. I'll continue to roll back slowly.

jordan: thanks — leaving full logs and links to dashboards in the ticket. I'll be available for questions.

emily-cs: sending customer follow-ups to impacted list now.

maria: incident status: mitigation successful for now, brownouts & rate-limits active, canary reroute in place, staged drains done. Monitoring window 1h.

oncall-2: continuing to monitor and will update thread with each 15m status. next check-in in 15m.

note: incident remains open while mitigations are active.
